newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close 1.70 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close 1.70 percent lower.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed 1.7 percent lower in a weak market on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 24.43 points down at 1,416.69 amid 194 losers and 63 gainers. Volume fell to 32 million shares from Monday's 49 million.

A dealer at Finex Securities said recent declines in the index and trading volume were alarming at a time when there was little negative news and prices of Global Depositary Receipts of Pakistani stocks traded abroad were stable.
"At present, all the market indicators point towards an extremely weak market, which may head towards its lowest level if it breaks its next support level of 1,395," the dealer said.
PTCL fell 1.10 rupees to 27, HUBCO 0.60 to 33, ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 21.75, PSO 7.00 to 365, Fauji Fertilizer 1.85 to 66.65, FFC Jordan 0.40 to 14.35 and Dhan Fibres 0.30 to 6.10.
